sources.note: SIL survey of remembered indigenous vocabulary among Nordeste groups; listed in Fabre's Kapinawá bibliography. Fieldwork predates the Kapinawá ethnonym, so it almost certainly contains no Kapinawá data, but it is the one linguistic survey of the region to confirm absence.
